policies.detail: Shell commands are risk-tiered by shell_command_risk() before execution. Known read-only patterns (ls, cat, git status, pytest) short-circuit to allow; destructive patterns (rm -rf, git reset --hard, mkfs, curl | sh) deny; everything else falls through to Claude Code's native permission prompt.
policies.name: Bash

policies.detail: PowerShell path. Same risk tiers as Bash. Windows-specific destructive patterns (Remove-Item -Recurse -Force, iwr | iex) are caught by shell_command_risk.
policies.name: PowerShell

policies.detail: Filesystem read. Sensitive paths (.env, credentials, ~/.ssh) are caught by targets_sensitive_path() before this policy runs.
policies.name: Read

policies.detail: File overwrite. Injection scan runs on the content field; protected-path check runs first so writes to hook_config or credential paths deny before this policy sees them.
policies.name: Write

policies.detail: Outbound HTTP with LLM post-processing. External network, so classed as external_message; url is sent to the fetcher and rendered content goes to a small model. Escalation threshold is 'payment' so it doesn't gate every doc lookup.
policies.name: WebFetch

policies.detail: Spawns a subagent. Metered because subagent runs consume tokens; classified above compute so per-session limits can bound cost. Prompt is scanned for injection like any other string leaf.
policies.name: Agent

policies.detail: Orchestrates many subagents. Higher escalation threshold because a workflow can spawn dozens of agents; a Workflow call without explicit opt-in should be reviewed.
policies.name: Workflow

policies.detail: Spawns a background process or WebSocket subscription. Compute (not write) because the monitor observes; any file mutations happen through the command that runs, which itself lands in Bash.
policies.name: Monitor

policies.detail: Cross-session or cross-agent message. Injection scan runs on the message body; PII scrubber flags a message that carries an email or badge number outside a documented handoff.
policies.name: SendMessage

policies.detail: Drafts feedback for Anthropic. Feedback content stays local until the user approves send.
policies.name: SendFeedback

policies.detail: Publishes to claude.ai. Default-private but URLs are shareable, so classed as external_message. Publish/read/list actions are all allowed; delete is naturally guarded by Claude Code's own confirm prompt.
policies.name: Artifact

policies.detail: Read/write against claude.ai/design projects. Uses OAuth-scoped session, so a call that lands on the wrong project surfaces as an auth error, not a data leak.
policies.name: DesignSync

policies.detail: Session-only recurring prompt. Config change because the schedule persists across turns; auto-expires at 7 days.
policies.name: CronCreate

policies.detail: Leaves a git worktree; removal is destructive. escalate_if_severity_gte=config_change catches removals through the escalate path; discard_changes=true triggers Claude Code's own confirm.
policies.name: ExitWorktree
